content: Just as a chariot cannot roll upon a single wheel, human destiny cannot advance without effort joined to destiny.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Yatha hyekena chakrena na rathasya gatir bhavet (यथा ह्येकेन चक्रेण न रथस्य गतिर्भवेत्) — Chanakya Niti
explanation: Fatalists sit with folded hands waiting for fate to deliver success, while arrogant technocrats believe their personal willpower alone controls the cosmos. Both are crippled. Effort is the left wheel; cosmic destiny is the right. You must turn your wheel with all your heart.
practicalInsight: Do not wait for lucky breaks. Put in the disciplined, sweat-stained labor today, trusting that fortune meets effort.
reflectionPrompt: Are you using 'fate' as an excuse for laziness, or are you exhausting yourself trying to control things that belong to the universe?
